# ZUFEK PRECISION — English

> DONGGUAN ZUFEK PRECISION CO., LTD. — custom metal screws and drawing-defined fasteners.

## Company facts
- Established: 2005. Location: Dalang, Dongguan, Guangdong, China.
- Address: 1st Floor, No. 353, Fuyuan District, Songmushan, Dalang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong, China.
- Engineering contact: info@zufek.net
- Monthly capacity: approximately several million parts, depending on product mix.
- Tooling and sampling: approximately 10–15 days, subject to drawing review and confirmation; repeat-production delivery is quoted separately.
- Automotive supply-chain background does not imply direct Mercedes-Benz or BMW OEM approval. Application studies are illustrative design examples, not delivered customer cases or measured test results.
- Theo Wan is the editorial author name; no unverified engineering credentials or certifications are implied.
- Materials, strength, tolerances, finishing, inspection, quantity and delivery are confirmed for the actual drawing.

## Technical articles

- [What to include in a custom screw RFQ](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-screw-quotation-checklist/): A useful quotation starts with a clear specification. A drawing is the best starting point, but a sample, sketch or assembly description can also help define the next questions.
- [A practical guide to shoulder screw drawings](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/shoulder-screw-drawing-guide/): A shoulder screw drawing needs separate bore-fit, axial-stack, thread and final-surface requirements. Check both tolerance limits before sample approval.
- [Five questions before specifying a captive screw](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/captive-screw-design-questions/): Specify a captive screw with its panel, retainer and mating thread. Review installation, released travel and tightened engagement as separate conditions.
- [Choosing material for a custom metal screw](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/material-selection-custom-screws/): Material selection begins with the service environment and mechanical requirements. The best specification balances function, manufacturability, availability and verification.
- [What affects the price of a non-standard screw?](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-screw-price-factors/): A custom screw quotation reflects the complete specification and order conditions. Understanding the cost drivers can make a design review more productive.
- [How to prepare an inspection plan for custom screws](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-screw-inspection-plan/): Build an inspection plan one characteristic at a time. For each drawing requirement, record the acceptance condition, a suitable method, the inspection stage and coverage, and the evidence retained. The worked rows below show how to turn a shoulder-screw drawing into an inspection record.
- [Cold heading or CNC turning: choosing a custom screw route](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/cold-heading-vs-cnc-custom-screws/): Choose the manufacturing route around geometry, quantity, material and required condition. A lower cycle cost does not always offset tooling or secondary work.
- [High-strength screw coatings and hydrogen-risk review](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/high-strength-screw-coatings-hydrogen-risk/): A high-strength steel fastener needs a coating decision that considers both corrosion and hydrogen exposure throughout processing.
- [304, 316 and 17-4PH: different heat-treatment questions](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/stainless-screw-heat-treatment-grades/): Stainless steel describes several material families. Specify the grade and final condition rather than writing one generic heat-treatment instruction.
- [Shoulder fits, thread classes and when grinding matters](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/shoulder-fit-thread-class-grinding/): A shaft fit and a thread tolerance class control different interfaces. Write the required function clearly before deciding how the surfaces must be finished.
- [How to specify a tamper-resistant screw drive](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/specifying-security-screw-drive/): Specify the drive profile, matching tool, finish and installed access together. A bit that fits a loose screw may still fail to engage inside the housing.
- [Hollow screw bores: the details an RFQ should include](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/hollow-screw-bore-specification/): Specify the complete bore, minimum remaining wall, internal edges and acceptance method. Use thread-root geometry and bore offset in the section review.
- [Designing the bearing face of a custom flange screw](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-flange-bearing-face/): Match the flange bearing face to the actual supporting surface. Compare the contact footprint, finish and grip length before replacing a separate washer.
- [Knurled thumb screws: specifying grip and adjustment](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/knurled-thumb-screw-grip-design/): A hand-adjusted screw must be accessible, comfortable to grip and compatible with the required adjustment. Head texture alone does not define how the mechanism works.
- [Cone, flat, dog or cup: choosing a set-screw tip](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/set-screw-tip-selection/): Choose a set-screw point by its contact with the mating part. Define allowable marking, adjustment and retention, then verify the complete joint.
- [T-slot bolt fit: what to measure before ordering](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/t-slot-bolt-head-fit/): A T-head must enter, turn or slide inside the intended slot while retaining the required contact. The slot cross-section is therefore an essential part of the fastener RFQ.
- [Eye bolts for linkages and lifting: different specification needs](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/eye-bolt-linkage-vs-lifting/): An eye-shaped end can belong to a linkage, a tensioning device or a lifting component. Similar appearance does not establish the same design requirements or approved use.
- [How to dimension a custom U-bolt](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/u-bolt-bend-and-leg-dimensions/): Inside width, bend shape and leg alignment determine whether a U-bolt fits the supported component. A clear drawing separates those features from the threaded connection.
- [Custom carriage bolts: specifying the square neck](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/carriage-bolt-square-neck/): The square neck is the functional anti-rotation feature of a carriage bolt. It should be matched to the mating hole and supporting material rather than treated as a cosmetic detail.
- [Eccentric screw drawings: making the offset unambiguous](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/eccentric-screw-datum-drawing/): An eccentric feature needs a clear reference axis. Without a datum scheme, two manufacturers can interpret an apparently simple offset drawing differently.
- [Double-ended studs: preventing mixed-thread assembly errors](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/double-ended-stud-thread-identification/): Different threads at the two ends can solve an interface problem and create an identification problem. The drawing, inspection plan and packaging should distinguish each end clearly.
- [Reduced-shank screws: why transitions need attention](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/reduced-shank-transition-design/): A narrow center section changes the geometry of a threaded connection. Its purpose and transition details must be defined before the manufacturing route is selected.
- [Tapered screws: defining the mating seat](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/tapered-screw-mating-seat/): A taper works against a corresponding surface. Its angle, axial position and relationship to the thread must be considered with the mating component.
- [Integral locating pins: coordinating pin and screw datums](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/integral-locating-pin-position/): Combining a small locating pin with a screw can reduce separate components, but the locating and clamping functions still need distinct specifications.
- [Multi-step screws: controlling the axial dimension chain](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/multi-step-screw-dimension-chain/): Several shoulders can locate several components. A clear dimension scheme explains which axial distances control the assembly and which are consequences of other dimensions.
- [Custom clinch studs: specify the panel as well as the fastener](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/clinch-stud-panel-requirements/): A press-in connection depends on the panel, hole and installation process. A custom stud cannot be evaluated as an isolated threaded shape.
- [Rolled or cut threads: questions to resolve in the RFQ](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/rolled-vs-cut-thread-rfq/): Thread generation is a process choice, while thread geometry and acceptance are product requirements. A complete RFQ explains both without confusing the method with a guaranteed result.
- [Cross holes in screws: planning burr control and inspection](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/cross-hole-burr-control/): A drilled cross hole creates entry and exit edges, and may intersect another feature. The RFQ should define those edges as carefully as the hole location.
- [Coating allowance for threads and precision shoulders](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/coating-allowance-thread-shoulder/): A coating belongs in the dimensional plan. The final fit must be evaluated in the condition that the customer receives, not only before surface treatment.
- [Nickel plating and stainless passivation: different RFQ requirements](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/nickel-plating-vs-stainless-passivation/): A bright appearance does not identify a surface process. Specify the substrate and required surface function before choosing between plating, passivation or another treatment.
- [What to specify for a zinc-flake coated custom screw](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/zinc-flake-coating-specification/): A coating-family name does not define the complete supplied surface. Custom fastener RFQs should connect the coating system with fit, friction and acceptance requirements.
- [Technical cleanliness: writing a useful fastener requirement](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-fastener-technical-cleanliness/): Cleanliness becomes a technical requirement when contamination can affect the assembly. Define what needs to be removed, how it is measured and how the clean condition is protected.
- [Pre-applied locking patches: what the screw drawing should say](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/pre-applied-locking-patch-rfq/): A pre-applied locking feature needs a defined material, location and assembly requirement. A colored patch shown in a photograph is not a complete specification.
- [Preassembled washer screws: specify the complete set](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/preassembled-washer-screw-specification/): A preassembled screw is supplied as a small assembly. The washer, retention method and component sequence need the same control as the screw itself.
- [What CCD vision inspection can check on a custom screw](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/ccd-screw-dimension-inspection/): Camera-based dimensional inspection can evaluate visible features of a screw, but the image, setup and inspection program must match the requirement. It is one part of a complete acceptance plan.
- [First-article approval for custom screws: a practical handoff](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/first-article-custom-screw-approval/): A sample is most useful when its identity, revision and acceptance scope are clear. First-article planning connects the approved drawing with the evidence needed before the next production decision.
- [Sampling and 100% inspection: choosing the right coverage](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/sampling-vs-full-fastener-inspection/): Inspection coverage should follow the characteristic and acceptance plan. Saying that a non-standard screw needs full inspection leaves the method, features and evidence undefined.
- [Thread gauges and custom screw acceptance](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/thread-gauge-acceptance-plan/): Thread acceptance begins with the specified thread system and fit. The gauge, supplied finish and inspection method should all refer to that same requirement.
- [Why a custom screw needs more than a generic torque value](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/tightening-torque-friction-custom-screws/): A tightening instruction belongs to the joint, not just the screw diameter. Friction, bearing conditions and the assembly method influence the relationship between tightening torque and clamp load.
- [From prototype to production: keeping the screw specification aligned](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/prototype-to-production-fasteners/): A prototype can establish useful geometry without defining the final production route. Plan the transition so the approved function and acceptance requirements survive the change in manufacturing method.
- [Drawing revision control for repeat custom fastener orders](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/drawing-revision-custom-fastener-orders/): Repeat orders should repeat the approved specification, not the ambiguities of an old email. A small revision-control habit can prevent expensive confusion across drawings, samples and inspection records.
- [Packaging and lot traceability for custom screw orders](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/blog/custom-screw-packaging-lot-traceability/): Packaging is part of the delivered condition. It should protect functional surfaces, preserve identification and make the incoming inspection and assembly process practical.
- [EV charging enclosures: why fastener specifications must follow the joint](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/ev-charging-enclosure-fasteners/): Review EV charging enclosure screws through joint function, gasket stack, security access, coating and an agreed inspection plan.
- [Factory automation: specifying locating and pivot fasteners for repeatable assemblies](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/automation-locating-pivot-fasteners/): How automation teams can specify shoulder screws for locating, pivoting and adjustment, with controlled interfaces and repeat-order evidence.
- [Battery energy storage equipment: defining fastener interfaces beyond the material grade](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/battery-storage-fastener-interfaces/): Specify battery storage fasteners by mechanical or electrical function, material condition, coating, cleanliness and traceable acceptance.
- [Data-centre equipment: fastener decisions for cooling, service access and controlled assembly](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/data-centre-cooling-service-fasteners/): Review data-centre equipment fasteners for service access, captive retention, controlled passages, cleanliness and final-condition inspection.
- [Repairability and product information: what custom fastener buyers should define now](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/repairability-product-information-fasteners/): Connect repair access, replacement-part control and evidence-backed product information without assuming universal passport obligations for screws.
- [Material supply risk: qualifying fastener alternatives without losing the approved interface](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/industry-insights/material-supply-risk-qualified-alternatives/): Qualify alternative fastener materials through final properties, manufacturability, treatment, fit, documentation and controlled release.

## Manufacturing processes

- [Custom Fastener Manufacturing Routes & Processes](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/): Cold heading, CNC turning, hybrid manufacturing and hot forging: explore threading, secondary machining, heat treatment, coatings, cleaning and inspection.
- [Multi-Station Cold Heading](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/cold-heading/): Wire is cut and formed through a sequence of dies. Head, flange and some shoulder features can be integrated into a repeatable production route.
- [Swiss-Type & CNC Turning](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/cnc-turning/): Bar-fed turning and turn-mill operations create drawing-specific steps, bores and other details with flexible programming.
- [Hot Heading & Forging](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/hot-forging/): Heated stock can be formed into larger or heavier geometries before finishing operations define the final interfaces.

- [Thread Rolling, Cutting & Tapping](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/threading/): The thread profile, material and batch conditions determine whether rolling, cutting, grinding or an internal tapping process is appropriate.
- [Secondary & Precision Operations](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/secondary-machining/): Local holes, flats, grooves and finished diameters often create the functional difference in a non-standard fastener.
- [Material-Specific Heat Treatment](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/heat-treatment/): Heat-treatment selection follows the alloy, required condition and applicable acceptance specification. One sequence cannot be applied to every screw.

- [Cleaning, Locking & Assembly](https://precision-custom-fasteners-yang.boldshrew261.chatgpt.site/capabilities/post-processing/): Cleanliness, burr control and pre-applied features are part of the finished-part specification, not an afterthought.
